description: SYNTHETIC UNIT-TEST SCENARIO — not real TTC figures, never score a real document against this file. Invented round numbers paired with tests/fixtures/gold/synthetic/ttc_annual_2024_pages.txt so the eval machinery (precision / flag-recall) can be exercised offline. Each row is a true figure a correct extractor should return within `tolerance` (relative). `should_flag` marks rows that a healthy extractor should mark low-confidence (or that validation should flag) because the source figure is ambiguous, restated, or unit-confusing. The eval guards precision (clean values within tolerance) and flag-recall (the hard rows get flagged).
